description: Makes a deterministic linked worktree the execution boundary for every task and adds parallel-safe serialized integration.
delta: Every task now runs in a deterministic linked worktree with one sequential writer; handoffs identify that worktree and its commits; review reuses it without switching the primary checkout; and final integration serializes validated no-fast-forward merge commits while retaining blocked task state.
verification: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes, including two worktrees created from one main commit and serial combined-tree integration
a clean upgrade from 1.1.41 installs the isolated-worktree capabilities while preserving consumer-owned text outside protected regions
